answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 12 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 200 identities costs 200 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. The sparrow of the design is public, the umber of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the atlas of honest work is what finally pays.
